name: Kosovo
summary: Possessing drugs is a crime: fine plus 1–3 yrs; a first offence with under 3 g: fine or up to 1 yr. Using drugs in public is a minor offence (fine €100–1,000 or up to 30 days). Dealing: 2–8 yrs.
poisonControlNote: No poison information centre is listed in WHO's 2023 directory; call 112 or 194.
callingForHelp: No Good Samaritan law or other specific legal protection for people who call for help in an overdose was found.

lsd.note: UN Schedule I. Possession: fine + 1–3 yrs; first offence under 3 g: fine or up to 1 yr (CC art. 269).

mushrooms.note: Psilocybin is UN Schedule I; mushrooms presumably treated likewise. Possession: fine + 1–3 yrs; first offence under 3 g: fine or up to 1 yr (CC art. 269).

dmt.note: UN Schedule I. Possession: fine + 1–3 yrs; first offence under 3 g: fine or up to 1 yr (CC art. 269).

mescaline.note: UN Schedule I; cacti status not confirmed. Possession: fine + 1–3 yrs; first offence under 3 g: fine or up to 1 yr (CC art. 269).

dox.note: DOM, DOB, DOC: UN Schedule I. Possession: fine + 1–3 yrs; first offence under 3 g: fine or up to 1 yr (CC art. 269).

nbomes.note: UN Schedule I since 2015; the code also covers 'analogues'. Possession: fine + 1–3 yrs; first offence under 3 g: fine or up to 1 yr (CC art. 269).

2c-x.note: 2C-B is UN Schedule II. Possession: fine + 1–3 yrs; first offence under 3 g: fine or up to 1 yr (CC art. 269).

2c-t-x.note: Not UN-controlled; may fall under the Criminal Code's 'analogue' provisions – not confirmed.

5-meo-xxt.note: Not UN-controlled; may fall under the Criminal Code's 'analogue' provisions – not confirmed.

cannabis.note: Possession: fine + 1–3 yrs; first offence under 3 g: fine or up to 1 yr (CC art. 269). Cultivation: 1–10 yrs. No medical cannabis.

ketamine.note: Anaesthetic used in hospitals and veterinary practice; not UN-controlled and national control status not confirmed.

mxe.note: UN Schedule II since 2016. Possession: fine + 1–3 yrs; first offence under 3 g: fine or up to 1 yr (CC art. 269).

dxm.note: Not UN-controlled; national control and prescription status not confirmed.

nitrous.note: Not internationally controlled; no national restriction confirmed.

amphetamines.note: UN Schedule II. Possession: fine + 1–3 yrs; first offence under 3 g: fine or up to 1 yr (CC art. 269).

mdma.note: UN Schedule I. Possession: fine + 1–3 yrs; first offence under 3 g: fine or up to 1 yr (CC art. 269).

cocaine.note: 1961 Convention drug. Possession: fine + 1–3 yrs; first offence under 3 g: fine or up to 1 yr (CC art. 269).

ghb/gbl.note: GHB is UN Schedule II. Possession: fine + 1–3 yrs; first offence under 3 g: fine or up to 1 yr (CC art. 269). GBL status not confirmed.

opioids.note: Heroin etc. are controlled. Possession: fine + 1–3 yrs; first offence under 3 g: fine or up to 1 yr (CC art. 269).

tramadol.note: Prescription-only painkiller; not UN-controlled and national control status not confirmed.

maois.note: MAOI antidepressants are prescription-only; harmala/Syrian rue status not confirmed; ayahuasca contains DMT (controlled).
